macro.shell.title: Shell commands
macro.shell.help: Pages can show the output of shell commands with the "Shell command" macro. A command only runs after a superadmin has approved exactly this command text; every change needs a new approval. Commands run with a timeout as an unprivileged user.
macro.shell.disabled: Shell macros are switched off on this server (plugins.macros.shell_enabled in config.yaml). Approved commands do not run until they are switched on.
macro.shell.no_approver: You can see the commands but not approve them. Only superadmins listed in plugins.macros.shell_approvers in config.yaml (e.g. {user}) or the local command line can approve.
macro.shell.command_help: Executed with /bin/sh -c. Leading and trailing spaces are ignored.
macro.shell.approve_confirm:
Approve this command? It will run on the server whenever a page with it is viewed:

{command}
macro.shell.delete_confirm: Delete this command from the list? Pages that use it will request a new approval.
macro.shell.empty: No commands yet. They appear here as soon as a page uses the shell macro.
perm.macro.shell.manage_help: Define and approve the commands of the shell macro (approvers must also be listed in config.yaml).
